__inputs.name: DS_REALUPTIME
__inputs.label: RealUptime Monitor
__inputs.description: The RealUptime Monitor data source (packages/grafana-datasource, REA-566), configured with a RealUptime API base URL and a read-scoped API key.

title: RealUptime Monitor
description: Starter dashboard for the RealUptime Monitor data source plugin (REA-566): uptime, latency and status-code panels over the plugin's own GET /api/v1/checks/results query, with incident annotations. Plugin-native twin of the Prometheus starter at apps/web/public/grafana/realuptime-monitor-dashboard.json (REA-565) -- use this one when scraping isn't set up, or when you want per-check history beyond current state.

panels.title: Uptime %
panels.description: One series per check/region. Downsamples server-side via GET /checks/results?step=... as the panel's own $__interval widens.

panels.title: Latency (p50 / p95)
panels.description: p50/p95 once the panel's interval crosses the API's minimum bucket width (10s); raw per-result latency below that.

panels.title: HTTP status code
panels.description: Always raw (never bucketed -- a downsampled result has no single status code to report).
